scoring_justification: Recompute migration barriers from IS/TS adsorption energies in results.json and compare to paper‑reported reference barriers and the required trend that I‑doped barriers are lower than pristine ones.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper‑reported barrier values for pristine Path I and Path II
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper’s Table 4 and conclusion text: Path I barrier ≈ 0.59 eV, Path II barrier ≈ 0.61 eV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper; tolerances of ±0.1 eV are chosen to absorb code/functional differences.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly from the published paper; tolerances are generous enough to accept a correct re‑run while excluding gross errors.

outputs.description: Initial-state and transition-state adsorption energies for four Li-ion migration paths. The checker recomputes migration barriers (barrier = TS - IS) and evaluates whether the iodine-doped barriers are lower than the pristine barriers and whether the barriers are within physically reasonable bounds.

output_contract.notes: Only the I-doped case and pristine reference are reproduced; F, Cl, Br cases and benchmark recalculations omitted.
